storeInfo.title: FasterARK Plugin Store
storeInfo.author: FasterARK powerup
storeInfo.description: Plugins, homebrew and emulators for ARK-5, installed with one button.

entries.title: ARK-5
entries.author: PSP-Arkfive
entries.description: The custom firmware itself, as released by FasterARK powerup. Updating downloads the ARK updater from the latest release and starts it: it updates ARK and the Plugin Manager, keeps your settings and plugins, and restarts the console.
entries.notes: Keep the battery charged, or the charger plugged in, while the updater runs.

entries.title: Plugin Manager
entries.author: FasterARK powerup
entries.description: This app. Browse, install, update and remove plugins and homebrew for ARK-5 without a PC. Your plugins can also be listed in the XMB, in a Plugins category you turn on in the settings.

install.text: Plugin Manager was updated. Restart it to use the new version.

entries.title: XMB Item Hider
entries.author: Frostegater, wad11656 & Exceen
entries.description: Hide any XMB item, or whole XMB categories such as Network. Edit SEPLUGINS/xmbih.ini and set an item to 1 to hide it, or a HIDE_ALL_ category to 2 to remove the category. Also relocates ARK's Extras items and can start the XMB on the Memory Stick. Tested on ARK-4 and ARK-5.
entries.notes: Setting HIDE_ALL_PSN = 2 also hides the Plugins category, which uses the PlayStation Network slot.

install.text: Edit SEPLUGINS/xmbih.ini to choose what to hide.

entries.title: Game Categories Lite
entries.author: codestation, ticky & wad11656
entries.description: Organize your games and homebrew into categories. Create folders named CAT_Something inside PSP/GAME or ISO and they appear as categories in the Game column. Configure it in XMB > Settings > System Settings. This build is compatible with XMB Item Hider.

entries.title: CheatDevice Remastered
entries.author: Freakler
entries.description: The ultimate cheat and mod menu for GTA Liberty City Stories and GTA Vice City Stories, including user scripts, teleports, an editor and much more. It is only loaded for the supported game IDs. On a PSP-1000 the Lite version is installed automatically.

install.runlevel: ULUS10041 ULES00182 ULES00151 ULUS10160 ULES00502 ULES00503 ULUS01826 ULUS11826 ULUX80146 ULET00417
ULUS10041 ULES00182 ULES00151 ULUS10160 ULES00502 ULES00503 ULUS01826 ULUS11826 ULUX80146 ULET00417

install.text: Set CPU Clock in Game to 333 in the Custom Firmware Settings for a smoother experience.

entries.title: TempAR
entries.author: raing3
entries.description: A complete cheat device for PSP and PS1 games (rewrite of NitePR/MKULTRA) with CWCheat and Action Replay code support, searcher, memory editor and more. Press R + HOME in game to open the menu.

entries.title: CDDA Enabler
entries.author: Total_Noob
entries.description: Enables CDDA (CD audio) tracks in homemade PS1 EBOOTs on every firmware after 4.01, without needing POPSLoader.

entries.title: ZeroVSH Patcher
entries.author: NightStar3 & codestation
entries.description: Customize the XMB without writing to flash0: files placed in PSP/VSH are loaded instead of the ones in flash0. Also enables the PSP Go clock and calendar on other models (not on PSP-1000).

install.text: Put the replacement flash0 files in PSP/VSH and restart the XMB.

entries.title: RemoteJoyLite
entries.author: Kethen (original by Hiroki)
entries.description: Stream the PSP screen to your computer over USB and control the PSP with a PC gamepad. Needs the RemoteJoyLite PC client from the GitHub release. Disable Use Extra Memory, Inferno Cache and Memory Stick Speedup on PSP-2000 and newer.

entries.title: PRO Online (aemu)
entries.author: Kethen and the PRO Online team
entries.description: Play ad-hoc multiplayer games online over the internet, with other PSPs, PS Vitas and PPSSPP. Write the SSID of your Wi-Fi hotspot into SEPLUGINS/hotspot.txt after installing. Recommended settings: CPU Clock in Game 333, Use Extra Memory Auto, Memory Stick Speedup Off, Inferno Cache Off, WLAN Power Save Off.

install.text: Write your hotspot SSID into SEPLUGINS/hotspot.txt.
PSP Go: aemu also expects kd/ and seplugins/ on the other storage device.

entries.title: CMFileManager
entries.author: joel16
entries.description: A full featured file manager: copy, move, rename and delete files, extract zip/7z/rar/tar archives, view images, play music, edit text files and browse over FTP.

entries.title: DaedalusX64
entries.author: DaedalusX64 team
entries.description: The Nintendo 64 emulator for the PSP, with Media Engine accelerated audio. Put your ROMs in PSP/GAME/DaedalusX64/Roms.

install.text: Copy your N64 ROMs to PSP/GAME/DaedalusX64/Roms.

entries.title: PSPLink
entries.author: pspdev
entries.description: Developer tool: run and debug homebrew straight from your computer over USB with pspsh, usbhostfs and GDB.

entries.title: PicoDrive
entries.author: notaz and irixxxx
entries.description: SEGA emulator: Mega Drive/Genesis, Mega CD, 32X, Master System, Game Gear, SG-1000 and Pico. Pick your ROMs, zipped or not, from anywhere on the memory stick with its file browser. Mega CD games also need the Mega CD BIOS, see readme.txt.

entries.title: Snes9xTYL mod
entries.author: yoyofr and esmjanus
entries.description: The classic SNES emulator for the PSP, in its last updated version. On a PSP it plays sound on the Media Engine, which makes it faster; on a PS Vita the build that works there is installed instead. Pick your ROMs with its file browser.

entries.title: Nazi Zombies: Portable
entries.author: NZ:P Team
entries.description: A zombie survival shooter in the style of Call of Duty's zombie mode, built on the Quake engine, with several maps. Runs on every PSP model. It always downloads the latest nightly build.
entries.notes: A 64 MB download: keep the charger plugged in.

entries.title: CrossCraft Classic
entries.author: CrossCraft
entries.description: An open source reimplementation of Minecraft Classic 0.30: build with every block of the creative mode, save your worlds and play online on Classic servers. It has its own textures and code, nothing from Mojang.

entries.title: Extreme Tux Racer
entries.author: chriopter (PSP port)
entries.description: Race Tux the penguin down snowy mountains and collect herring: a port of Extreme Tux Racer 0.8.4 with its courses and music. The port is new, from 2026, and its author tested it on a PSP at 333 MHz.

entries.title: UmdImageCreator
entries.author: sarami
entries.description: Dumps the UMD in the drive to the memory stick, like GodMode9 on the 3DS. Start it from the Game column with the disc in and press Circle: it writes ISO/<disc ID>.iso (UMD Video discs go to ISO/VIDEO/), which ARK lists in the Game column and plays like the disc. It also writes logs for checking the dump against Redump's database. Cross writes the logs only, Triangle quits. Built from the author's v1.7 source by FasterARK powerup.
entries.notes: Needs a UMD drive: not for the PSP Go or the PS Vita. Don't press Square, L or R: they run the author's test commands, which write files to the memory stick's root. The app says "Done" even when a read error stopped the dump early, so compare the ISO's size with the disc size in the log. Keep the charger plugged in.
